title: 【老闆急件】先備份並清空既有任務池，改為直接執行；全面重構派工底層
description: 老闆於 Telegram msg 1329 明確指示：第一步先對 storage/next_tasks.json 做可回復備份，之後清空既有任務；暫停把工作送進任務池，所有工作改為直接執行。接著第一個直接執行的工作是全面盤點並重構整個派工／認領／commit／殘留收斂底層，消除無人認領、無法 commit、任務池堵塞與舊機制殘留。這是 user-assigned P1 急件；須直接開工，不可只寫計畫或再拆成一般排隊單。依五步結案 gate：live 證據、根因層級、底層重構、回歸與下游回讀、制度化寫回；未全過只能標 contained。操作含清空任務池，務必先建立可驗證備份並保留回復路徑。完成後以 Telegram 回報短結論與可查證證據。
containment_evidence: Program commit 15 safe reconcile production ownership slice is root_cause_fixed_and_verified: hourly feed-sync safe upserts now use one exact feed byte snapshot and route through the generation-owned immutable batch, private payload store, WorkItem, EffectRequest/outbox, primary lease, and typed settlement. Production rehearsal completed legacy/1 -> operations_core/2 -> legacy/3 exact rollback -> operations_core/4; current read-back shows work succeeded, effect/outbox delivered, local/Supabase 14/14 with drift 0. The tracked-snapshot selected suite passes 91/91 including the full 47-case PostgreSQL contract file, and the final schedule-equivalent command exits 0. Follow-up failure injections also closed the single and batch authority replacement windows between provider read-back and upsert: each actual mutation now revalidates the original lease epoch, and replacement yields zero writes and zero settlement with 82 adjacent tests passing. A separate zero-I/O destructive delete intent module now binds exact feed bytes, floor/cap, all five cascade families, deterministic recovery bytes, and explicit approval into one scope; 60 adjacent tests pass and no provider/hourly route exists. The overall umbrella remains contained because destructive delete still lacks its owner CAS, provider, restore executor, and live rollback, while program commit 34 lacks a physical two-Mac receipt pair.
next_direct_step: Implement the destructive publisher-delete owner transaction and provider behind the new scope-bound contract: verify durable approval, re-read exact candidate/cascade bytes, fence authority immediately before each mutation, require typed absence read-back, and add an exact restore executor. Then run a manual-only live delete -> rollback -> convergence rehearsal without granting delete authority to the unattended hourly safe job. Separately collect the two-physical-Mac authority receipt pair for program commit 34.
latest_checkpoint: Destructive delete now has a separate zero-I/O intent contract: exact canonical feed bytes, floor/cap, unique remote candidates, all five cascade families and deterministic recovery JSONL are one immutable scope; only a durable approval bound to that exact scope can materialize a destructive EffectRequest. Contract plus Effect Delivery, safe reconcile, legacy delete and feed-sync adjacent suites pass 156/156. No provider or hourly route was added, so zero remote mutation occurred. Owner CAS, approval verifier, delete/read-back, restore and live rollback remain before program commit 15 can close.
